cells.gaps: No source found of a route to send data without the authority's authorisation, or of a ratification of the Malabo Convention.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The authority requires authorisation before personal data leaves Eswatini [SWZ-001] and no route without it is named, so the rule is protected but closed and the stage is 2. The application form [SWZ-002] is a procedure for permission, not a way to send data without asking.
